entities.summary: Jan Joakim Strand is a Finnish politician currently serving in the Parliament of Finland for the Swedish People's Party of Finland representing the Vaasa constituency since 2015. On 5 July 2024 he replace Anders Adlercreutz as Minister of European Affairs and Ownership Steering.
